control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dark): if the line tracker reads below 90 % curve left, else if above 90 % curve right, else call avoidWalls; else (bright) call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %: if an obstacle is on the left turn right 20°, else if on the right turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left, else curve right.
